entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. My order number is VF88091.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. It's fine. I just don't want it.
I understand. Looking at the delivery date, I see it was received 26 days ago...
And? I tried to return it on day nine. Your entire website was down. I think it was Christmas Eve. There was a big website error message and nothing would load.
I see. Let me check our system status for that date. One moment.
Okay, yes, I am seeing a note about a known outage. Our whole return portal system was down for several hours that day. Did you happen to get a screenshot of the error page?
No, I didn't take a screenshot. I just closed the window when I realized I couldn't print the label. It wasn't my job to document your technical problems.

I completely understand and I do apologize for that frustration. Not a problem at all. I can see you made a valid attempt. According to our policy here, you have 90 days for a return anyway, so you're well within the window. I'll go ahead and process this for you now.
Oh. Fine. Whatever. Just send the label to my email.

Of course. I've just initiated the return. You will receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Your reference number for this call is 774-301. Is there anything else I can help with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
